topic: Squinting at your phone? Font size and display settings that help

youtube.title: Squinting at your phone? Do this, not that 📱 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Squinting at your phone? Do this, not that. 📱
போனில் எழுத்து படிக்க கஷ்டமா?

• After about 40, the lens inside the eye gets stiffer, so near focus gets harder (presbyopia).
• Do: increase font size and display zoom, and turn on bold text.
• Do: match screen brightness to the room and hold the phone at a comfortable distance.
• Don't: scroll in a dark room or hold the phone close to your nose.
• If you push the phone farther away to read, you may need reading power.
